reuse.why: Calls the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and bankSync.syncAccount, but takes the per-provider link body and download function by copying Akahu's rather than factoring them.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is the Akahu link body (upgrade-or-create, payee, initial sync, sync-event) copied with names changed, and downloadFintegraTransactions is downloadAkahuTransactions copied line for line.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, base path in server-config.ts and type in types/models, matching where each provider's pieces live.

scope.why: Only the provider registration, link handler, download path, config and types needed for Fintegra; client edits are the minimum the provider union forces.

maintainability.why: A sixth near-identical link function and a fifth near-identical download function grow the copy set any future linking fix must touch.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared linker exists in this tree to bypass; the shared single-link guard assertBankAccountNotLinked is used.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount and downloadAkahuTransactions are open copies with only names/strings changed.
